items.label: Correspondances
items.value: count(palbox.pals | where((inputs.nom = "" or contains(lower(species_id), lower(inputs.nom)) or contains(lower(nickname), lower(inputs.nom))) and level >= inputs.niveau_min and (inputs.genre = "tous" or gender = inputs.genre) and (not inputs.elite_seulement or talents.hp >= 60)))
